daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is pushing you to dig deeper into ideas that matter. With the Moon trining this placement, your communication hits different—you're seeing through surface-level stuff and ready to have real conversations about what actually counts.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is making you genuinely magnetic right now. You're not trying too hard, just being authentically you, and that's exactly what draws people in. If you're coupled up, this is a solid day for deeper connection.
daily.career: Saturn retrograde in Aries is asking you to revisit past decisions without the pressure. Use today to refine a project or skill you've been working on. Your unconventional approach is your strength—lean into it.
daily.health: The Moon in Cancer wants you to actually rest today. It's not lazy; it's necessary. Hydrate, move your body gently, and check in with how you're feeling emotionally. Your nervous system will thank you.

weekly.overview: This week hits different as Mars charges into Virgo mid-week, sharpening your ability to execute plans you've been sitting on. The Sun-Mars square early week might feel like friction, but it's actually forcing you to get real about what you actually want. Best Day: Thursday. Watch-Out Day: Tuesday.
weekly.love: Venus is playing nice with Jupiter, so if you've been thinking about deepening something, the vibe is there—just don't rush it. Mars moving into Virgo by Wednesday brings precision to your feelings; you'll know exactly what you need instead of being wishy-washy about it.
weekly.career: Moon-Mars trine midweek is your power move window. This is when your ideas stop being theoretical and start being doable. Mars shifting into Virgo means details suddenly matter; use this to refine pitches, nail down proposals, or finally organize that chaos on your desk.
weekly.health: The Moon-Mars connection gives you energy to actually use, so channel it into movement or projects you've been procrastinating on. Early week might feel scattered, but by midweek you'll find your rhythm. Stay hydrated—Scorpio Mercury makes you mentally intense.
